blocks.text: The working capital program for {{fact:f:E-2013-001.client}} is moving on schedule, and I am writing mainly to line up the next batch of data and to confirm one date. The receivables and payables extracts your team sent over reconciled cleanly against the trial balance, which saved us a round of back-and-forth, and Brenda Rodriguez has already begun building the cash picture from them. Nothing in what we have seen so far changes the plan we set at kickoff.

The gap now is inventory. To finish the first cut, we need the month-end inventory balances and the standard cost file for the last two years, and, if it is easy to include, a note of how the warehouse system records stock in transit, since that is where these extracts usually disagree with the ledger. If your team can send those to me, John Vasquez, by the end of next week, we will keep the analysis on its timeline; anything you would rather we not circulate beyond the team, mark it and we will hold it close.
Jason Torres would also like to hold the next working session in the week of the twenty-third, and he will follow up with you, James Keller, to settle a time that suits your operations group.
